root_cause: The canonical content-loop treated pre/post outcome reconciliation and Instagram daily winner selection as terminal errors before invoking the independent blog/LinkedIn delivery lanes. A single external OAuth readback or IG signal could starve all channels.
prevention_rule: Record failed observational reconciliations and Instagram daily winner selection as degraded stage results without aborting other channels. Do not report GREEN when readback failed. Preserve token authentication, single content-loop lease, social permission, uniqueness gates, exact media proof, and provider verification.
